title: Tableau Data Insight Analyst / Tableau Data Engineer - Tableau Sales Report
text: Tableau Data Insight Analyst / Tableau Data Engineer - Tableau Sales Report at Infinity Pro (Sydney, CBD, Inner West & Eastern Suburbs; Contract/Temp; salary: Contract with view to go Perm + End User + Parking). Your Benefits: Contract with view to go Permanent; Large Global Brand; Organic Growth Opportunities; Brand-new High Profile Projects; Free Onsite Parking; End-user Organization; Friendly & Flat Structure; In this role you will be joining a first-tier reputable end-user organization. Their strong performance is the results of their years of investment in sensible Sales and Marketing Campaigns. Working with senior stakeholders across the sales and marketing function as well as the broader business units, you will be working across data mining and modeling as well as helping different business units to create better insight and visualize sales data. You need to have an eye for detail and creative thinking coupled with strong business acumen in order to plan an influential role in betterment of risk and control management across the enterprise. To be successful for this role, your CV will need to reflect on following skill-set: Strong command of English (written and verbal); Direct Experience with Tableau Data Visualization as well as Business Dashboards; Advanced skills with SQL OR R data mining; Demonstrated commercial experience in data manipulation and trend analysis using Excel and/or mathematical models; Demonstrated ability in internal or external consulting (i.e working with business stakeholders on requirement gathering all the way to delivery); Preferred but Not Essential Experience: Any experience with SAP HANA as a data source; Any qualification within mathematics / statistical data modeling; A background working within a FMCG, Retail, Supply Chain, B2B space. Important Note Relevant, recent commercial and local experience is absolutely essential to apply for this requirement. If you meet the above criteria you will need to Apply NOW in order to secure a place in the shortlist for the interviews. You can either apply here or send your application directly to Navid at Navid@infinitypro.com.au quoting 0010TSales or contact us on (02) 9687 1068 for a confidential discussion. Please ensure all documents are sent in Microsoft Word Format
